title: Integrate video exposure over real frame durations instead of frame counts

definition.title: Integrate video exposure over real frame durations instead of frame counts
definition.source_excerpt: Investigate an explicitly requested temporal box-exposure renderer for a variable-frame-rate timeline. FFmpeg's tmix provides an established frame-mixing baseline, but a fixed count of frames and fixed weights do not by themselves define duration-aware exposure. [S10] Model each admitted input picture F_i as held on [t_i,t_(i+1)). For output exposure [a,b): w_i = max(0, min(b,t_(i+1)) - max(a,t_i))     Y = (sum_i w_i F_i) / (b-a) For example, linear-light red held for 10 ms and blue held for 30 ms contribute 25% and 75% to a 40 ms exposure, not 50% each. The proposed optimization sweeps actual presentation events. For overlapping output exposures, subtract portions leaving the window and add portions entering it, rather than rendering many uniformly spaced temporal subframes or repeatedly visiting every contributing picture.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Identify the CPU/GPU representation boundary and actual useful work removed. Check existing renderer fusions, caches, kernel fast paths and hardware gates.
definition.minimum_probe: Small deterministic planes/blocks or an existing real frame with one adversarial edge. Use a bounded component test if GPU integration is not already available, labeling it as such.
definition.initial_screen: Identify the CPU/GPU representation boundary and actual useful work removed. Check existing renderer fusions, caches, kernel fast paths and hardware gates. Small deterministic planes/blocks or an existing real frame with one adversarial edge. Use a bounded component test if GPU integration is not already available, labeling it as such.
definition.primary_metric: Complete decode/process/present cost, transfers, command work or peak live storage for identical requested output.
definition.scope_contract: Exact integer planes or an explicitly defined numerical/altered-output contract; compare the final requested region and later references where relevant.
definition.negative_control: Change stride, crop, phase, alpha, edge neighborhood or resource generation; exercise a case where the proposed shortcut is ineligible.
definition.stop_boundary: No custom decoder rewrite or GPU platform port. Include staging/readback/cache cost; reject the current implementation rather than the general idea if the executor is a proxy.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Actual required API/format for any GPU claim; CPU algebra is a separate component observation, not browser qualification.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

prepare.basis: Implemented actual VideoFrame PTS/duration-driven GPU exposure accumulation for an explicitly requested64x64 opaque black/white linear-color intermediate. Independent Python Fraction oracle verifies10/30ms→exact0.75 atall4096pixels; splitting the30ms hold into3x10ms remains exactly0.75. Partial5/25ms exposure gives5/6 with1.99e-8 maximum float error, within unchanged1e-7bound; endpoint windows produceexact0/1. Framecountaverage0.5 fails, zero-duration/gapped/overlapping timelines reject, oldsource-epoch GPUresult isdiscarded whilefreshresult survives, allframes/buffers/devicesclose. Preserve two diagnosed failed implementations: GPU runtime normalization introduced1ulp above1 atwhiteendpoint; CPU-normalized duration weights alone stillfailedexactsplit invariance becauseGPU byte255/255 conversion also usedapproximate division. Final admittedendpoint conversion usesexact0/1 selection plusnormalized durationweights; no tolerance relaxation or generalcolorspace claim. This qualifies a new duration-aware exposure intermediate, not ordinaryplayback averaging, HDR/generalcolor processing/displaytransfer or a speedimprovement. Performance isnotapplicable for this additionalcapability endpoint.
